title: CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4
author: Allison
description: Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, Apple no longer includes Intel (x86_64) code in some of the system binaries and libraries that CodeQL relies on to trace builds. As… The post CodeQL changes for macOS 27, Xcode 27, and Swift 6.4 appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: Starting with macOS 27 and Xcode 27, Apple no longer includes Intel (x86_64) code in some of the system binaries and libraries that CodeQL relies on to trace builds. As a result, CodeQL can’t support traced scans on these versions or analyze Swift 6.4.
takeaways: If you use GitHub Actions, pin the runner image and toolchain in your workflow rather than relying on the latest versions.
How to keep your scans running If you scan Swift or use traced builds for other languages, pin your workflows to macOS 26 or earlier and Xcode 26 or earlier.
